content_sections.heading: CMHO Bilaspur Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CMHO Bilaspur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CMHO Bilaspur Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CMHO Bilaspur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for MD Medicine Specialist, 2 for Anesthesia Specialist and 1 for Orthopedic Specialist.

content_sections.heading: CMHO Bilaspur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: MD Medicine Specialist: MD in Medicine with registration in CG Medical Council is compulsory. Anesthesia Specialist: MD/ DNB in Anesthesia with registration in CG Medical Council is compulsory. Orthopedic Specialist: MS Orthopedic/ Diploma in Orthopedic/ DNB in Orthopedic with registration in CG Medical Council is compulsory.

content_sections.heading: CMHO Bilaspur Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 70 years Age relaxation will be as per government rules. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CMHO Bilaspur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the CMHO Bilaspur Specialist Doctors recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Specialist Doctors posts at CMHO Bilaspur is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue within the specified registration time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Specialist Doctors posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MD/MS/DNB in the respective specialty and have a valid registration with the Chhattisgarh Medical Council to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Specialist Doctors?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Specialist Doctors positions at the Chief Medical and Health Office Bilaspur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Specialist Doctors role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Specialist Doctors posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 93,750 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Specialist Doctors posts ranges from a minimum of 18 years to a maximum of 70 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being done through a Walk-in Interview. Interested and eligible candidates need to appear at the designated venue on the specified date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the CMHO Bilaspur Specialist Doctors recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Which specialties are being recruited for?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for MD Medicine Specialist, Anesthesia Specialist, and Orthopedic Specialist positions.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs. Specific documents include ID proof, educational certificates, and CG Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before attending the interview.
